map.WebM/Opus 和 WAV 怎么选？: How do I choose between WebM/Opus and WAV?
map.WebM/Opus 体积小、适合网络传输与即时分享；WAV 为未压缩 PCM，适: WebM/Opus is small and suits network transfer and instant sharing; WAV is uncompressed PCM, suited to editing software or a DAW. This page's "Export WAV" renders offline with OfflineAudioContext using the current volume and playback speed and encodes 16-bit WAV, while "Export original file" keeps the browser recording format; exporting WAV cannot restore detail already lost to Opus compression.
map.为什么有时录出来有杂音或爆音？: Why do recordings sometimes contain noise or clipping?
map.会议、采访或课堂现场用浏览器麦克风直接录音，实时看到波形与音量，结束即导出素材。: Record straight from the browser microphone for meetings, interviews or classes, watch the waveform and level live, and export the material when finished.
map.基于浏览器麦克风录音，实时波形与音量可视化，支持暂停/继续；可导出原始 WebM: Records with the browser microphone, shows waveform and level in real time, supports pause/resume; export the original WebM/MP4 file, or offline-render a 16-bit WAV with the current volume and speed. All recording is processed locally and never uploaded.
map.多为输入增益过高导致削波，或环境回授产生啸叫。可先降低麦克风增益、离声源 15~: Usually the input gain is too high and causes clipping, or the room feeds back and creates howling. First lower the microphone gain, stay 15-30 cm from the source, and record in a quiet environment; browser-local processing never uploads audio, so privacy stays under your control.
map.录制配音或播客干声，先试录几秒确认增益合适、无爆音与底噪后再正式录制。: When recording a voiceover or podcast dry track, test-record a few seconds first to confirm the gain is right and there is no clipping or noise floor, then record properly.
map.采集环境声或乐器素材，导出 WAV 得到未压缩 PCM 便于后期剪辑（细节仍受原: Capture ambience or instrument material and export WAV as uncompressed PCM for later editing (detail is still limited by the original recording codec).
map.首次使用需授权麦克风权限；不同浏览器支持的录音容器不同（WebM/Opus、MP: Microphone permission is required on first use; browsers support different recording containers (WebM/Opus, MP4 or OGG), and this page selects one via MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported. Recordings exist only on the current page and are lost on refresh or close, so download them first; WAV export renders offline with the current volume and speed and re-encodes, and cannot restore detail already lost in the original codec. This tool runs entirely in the front end and never uploads recordings.
map.：在浏览器中用 MediaRecorder 录音，常见约束为采样率 44100H: : in the browser, MediaRecorder is used for recording, with common constraints of 44100 Hz or 48000 Hz sample rate and mono or stereo. For a WebM/Opus container a bit rate around 128 kbps is enough for speech. "Export original file" keeps the recorded WebM/MP4 codec; "Export WAV" first decodes, then renders offline through OfflineAudioContext with the current volume and playback speed and encodes 16-bit PCM - giving an uncompressed WAV, but it cannot restore detail already lost to Opus compression. Before recording, use the live level meter to confirm the peak stays below 0 dBFS to avoid clipping.
